answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the wander is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the wharf of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a summit of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 126um.
